Cash and cash equivalents fell to Rp 1.41T (down 56% YoY), while inventories dropped to Rp 99.99M (down 41% YoY). Non-current assets totaled Rp 4.10T in 2024, down 33% YoY, mainly due to lower goodwill (Rp 39.66M vs Rp 776.94M) and joint venture investments (Rp 653.52M vs Rp 1.36T). Total liabilities are not shown, but asset reductions suggest a significant contraction in scale or asset liquidation.
